why: 824 markers are unbracketed (詩 486, 書 176, 易 137, 禮 25). They cannot be counted as citations nor discarded: in some hosts the bare name IS the established way to cite a work, and in others it is the author composing verse or writing a letter. Which one it is depends on the HOST, so it is declared per host rather than guessed per occurrence.

declared.basis: 左傳 cites the annals as 書; the convention is standard in 春秋 exegesis

measuredSupport.note: 64% is a LOWER BOUND. The misses are annals-style entries (`寔來`, `天王出居于鄭`, `鄭公子歸生弒其君夷。`) that look like 春秋 text, so they are matcher misses (short fragments and span boundaries), not counter-examples. Supported, not established.

notDeclared.why: 文選 is an anthology of verse; a bare 詩 there may be the poem being quoted or the poem being composed, and nothing in the text decides it
elsewhere 書 commonly means LETTER (遺羽書曰, 遺章邯書曰), which is why the naive detector reported 12,501 citations instead of 861

nonClaims: A convention is a claim about the HOST's usage, not a fact about the marker.
An undeclared host/marker pair stays unresolved and is reported as such — it is never silently counted.
